description: Codebase-memory indexing config for the sismo-cali-dashboard repo. Documents how the code knowledge graph is built so teammates re-index consistently. The graph DB itself is NOT committed (regenerate with index_repository); the ADR lives in docs/ADR.md and mirrored in the graph.

notes: integracion_F1/ is a separate git repo indexed as its own codebase-memory project.
Run `index_repository(repo_path='.', mode='full')` after significant code changes.
ADR: `manage_adr(mode='get')` reads it from the graph; docs/ADR.md is the versioned mirror.
